info.title: 集团人事行政 OA Commercial API
info.description: Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL commercial OA API contract for auth, IAM, people, approvals, attendance, finance, assets, resources, imports, files, audit, analytics, readiness, backup smoke verification, and frontend integration.

200.description: Database, database integrity, and file storage are ready

post.summary: Change own password, revoke old sessions, and return a refreshed token

get.summary: People overview with masked sensitive fields by default

post.summary: Audit-backed people export with required business reason
Add approval comment as authenticated actor
Create or update department approval rule
Submit leave request and linked workflow
Create payment or expense request and linked workflow
Create payroll batch and linked workflow
Borrow, return, repair, inventory, or retire asset
Regenerate asset QR version and image
Upload base64 attachment with checksum and audit

get.summary: Roles, permissions, and user role assignments

post.summary: Create account with initial roles and audited temporary password handling
Create one login account for each active employee missing an account

put.summary: Update role permissions and audit the change
Enable or disable account and revoke disabled sessions
Admin reset account password and revoke existing sessions

get.summary: Structured export records with actor, scope, filters, and row counts

runtime.description: Safe runtime flags without secrets, origins, or filesystem paths.

closurePlan.description: Safe release closure checklist without commands, paths, hostnames, database URLs, or raw blocker text.

ownerEvidenceChecklist.description: Safe owner-by-gap release evidence checklist without file paths, commands, hostnames, database URLs, checksums, or secrets.

hrDataReview.description: Safe HR data review package summary without paths or sensitive personnel fields.

gapActionReport.description: Safe owner handoff summary for open commercial gaps without evidence paths, commands, or blocker text.

latestEvidence.description: Safe latest commercial evidence summary without command output, filesystem paths, URLs, database names, or secrets.

artifactSummary.description: Safe evidence artifact inventory grouped by release phase without file paths or checksums.

signoffDrafts.description: Safe signoff-draft summary without absolute paths or plaintext secrets.

roleCodes.description: Roles assigned to every newly generated employee account.

credentials.description: One-time temporary credentials returned only to the authorized administrator and never written to audit logs.

businessReason.description: Required business purpose for auditability before any backend CSV export is generated.

includeSensitive.description: Only accepted by endpoints that explicitly support denied sensitive-export audit handling.

lastHash.description: Record hash at the tail of the tenant audit hash chain when signed rows exist.

approverUsers.description: Backend-resolved active user bindings for each approver label; unresolved labels keep userId null.

qrPayload.description: Safe internal asset QR payload without sensitive employee or financial fields.

qrImage.description: PNG data URL generated by the backend for browser rendering.

resourceId.description: Preferred durable resource id when known.

resourceName.description: Accepted for UI forms and imports when id is not available.
